text: APOE4 iPSC-derived human astrocytes showed cholesterol accumulation relative to isogenic APOE3 astrocytes; this is only a weak, indirect surrogate for endo-lysosomal dysfunction and does not measure endosome pH.
description: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE4 vs isogenic APOE3, generated by CRISPR/Cas9 editing. Abstract-only: the assay, culture details and units are not stated. Caveat: cholesterol accumulation is not a measure of endosomal pH and may arise through lipid-metabolism routes unrelated to acidification.

provenance.excerpt: APOE4 neurons exhibited increased synapse number and elevated Aβ<sub>42</sub> secretion relative to isogenic APOE3 cells while APOE4 astrocytes displayed impaired Aβ uptake and cholesterol accumulation.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased cholesterol accumulation in iPSC-derived astrocytes) [weak surrogate; endosome pH not measured]
